description: This file defines structures and functions for managing device authentication tokens, including storing, retrieving, and clearing tokens with persistence support via JSON encoding.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: A Codable and Sendable struct that represents an authentication token entry with associated role, scopes, and timestamp.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a token entry for a given device ID and role if available.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores or updates a token entry for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token entry for a specified device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace from each scope, filters out empty strings, removes duplicates, and sorts.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL for storing authentication data.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the token store from disk if available.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the token store to disk.
